caseName: R. C. Wetherall, Jr. v. State Road Commission of West Virginia
caseNameFull: WETHERALL Et Al. v. STATE ROAD COMMISSION OF WEST VIRGINIA Et Al.
attorneys: Carney M. Layne and Charles W. Yeager for appellants., C. Donald Robertson, Attorney General of West Virginia, Philip J. Graziani, Deputy Attorney General, and C. Robert Sarver, Assistant Attorney General, for appellees.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The motion to dismiss is granted and the appeal is dismissed. Price, dba Howard Price & Co. v. State Road Commission of West Virginia, ante, p. 20.
